findings.title: LLM call with no visible output guardrail
findings.explanation: A model is invoked but there is no nearby moderation, schema validation, or output filtering. Raw model output can contain injected instructions, unsafe content, or malformed data that downstream code trusts.
findings.remediation: Validate the model's output before using it: enforce a schema (e.g. Pydantic), run a moderation/safety check, and constrain it to an allowlist of expected actions.

findings.title: User input concatenated directly into a prompt
findings.explanation: A prompt is built by interpolating a variable into a template. If that variable contains untrusted user input, an attacker can override your instructions (prompt injection).
findings.remediation: Keep the system instruction in a separate message from user content. Pass user text as its own 'user' role message rather than splicing it into the system prompt, and validate/escape it first.
